checklistReconciliation.conclusion: The stock rescue-orbit emergency checklist is a baseline, not the flown final configuration. Apply time-tagged voice amendments and distinguish read-up from execution.
unambiguousDifferences: VHF removed from remaining functions; only one audio station retained.
PGNS was retained for PTC setup then removed at final deep powerdown.
IMU standby heater retained despite PGNS operate/DSKY off.
RCS A/B-2 heater breakers closed with panel3 switches off; do not infer heater state from breaker alone.
TRACK/FLOOD eventually opened after an initial instruction to leave lighting breakers closed.

established: 129Ah is reported LM-to-CM export across loads that include charging and pre-entry equipment. The reported CM battery reserve rose by 19Ah.
Section6.2 stage-delivery figures and section7.2.5 total-capacity figures do not close under one explicitly defined boundary.
TELMU189.6Ah usable reserve is distinct from Mission Report410Ah total remaining.
accountingResolution.requiredEvidence: Original per-battery integrated-current ledger or explicit author definition of stage-delivered charge, plus usable-capacity/reserve convention.
accountingResolution.implementationRule: Track LM housekeeping and CM export separately, debit both exactly once at the source, and compare only identically defined metrics/epochs.

validationCriteria.criterion: Represent final deep-powerdown execution near82:30 and final powerup start133:29; do not keep12A until136.
Tag30/12/12.5A summaries, individual current samples, planning40.7A and70A peak distinctly; never turn a peak into a duration.
Declare source-current, LM-housekeeping, CM-export, delivered and usable-reserve boundaries; no duplicate export subtraction.
Use equipment-derived loads and actual switch history to predict held-out current/capacity anchors; observations used to choose aggregate load cannot count as independent validation.
Set tolerances before comparison from telemetry resolution, calibration, time uncertainty and documented graph-reading uncertainty. No NASA50Ah acceptance band has been found.
Account for recorded unequal early bus sharing, battery5/6 connection times and battery3 withdrawal; equal sharing is not the flown history.
Retain exact deterministic Ah/Wh conservation and source exhaustion software tests separately from historical accuracy.

heldOutTargets.status: AVAILABLE FOR INDEPENDENT COMPARISON; NO MODEL PASS CLAIMED
heldOutTargets.qualification: Use only targets excluded from calibration of the model being evaluated. The existing aggregate scenarios already use some TELMU and PAO anchors.
heldOutTargets.componentModelScope: Optional source-constrained LM-8 design-power proxy comparisons and conditional battery replay; not a complete LM-7 flight-current prediction.
heldOutTargets.componentModelBlocker: Component subtotals are now evaluated separately from aggregate scenarios. LM-8 transfer uncertainty, historical starting battery allocations, omitted equipment, switching, thermal duties, unequal sharing and acceptance tolerances remain unresolved. Charger output, battery transient waveforms and usable reserves are not predicted.

targets.modelRequirement: Complete LM loads and simultaneous CM export input at the source.
CM input path, charger and entry battery state model.
Per-battery and bus transient dynamics, protection state and the observation cadence.
Unequal source sharing dependent on tap, delivered charge and terminal voltage.
Documented usable versus total charge and consistent source accounting boundary.

nextGateRecommendation: Use the new component-current and battery-history report to isolate missing demand and thermal sensitivity. Establish LM-7 applicability, thermostat/jet duty and missing full-mission switch history before assessing the held-out anchors with predeclared uncertainty. Resolve unequal battery sharing, initial history and export accounting before accepting reserve predictions. Full-flight validation remains OPEN.
